name: pmc-model-scenarios
description: Builds a Scenario Model with base, upside and downside for each option, the two or three drivers that separate them, every assumption marked, a sensitivity check and the early signals that tell you which scenario you are in, as an editable spreadsheet. Use for "run pmc-model-scenarios", "model base, upside and downside for the usage-based pricing option", "which assumption flips the answer?", "what early signal tells us we are in the downside?", "scenario model", "replace the single forecast line", part of the Claude Opus 5.5 for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
